bar.name: Opening Cut
bar.text: The first time you pay HP for a skill in a battle, that skill drains double through Vampiric Bite.

bar.name: Red Reserve
bar.text: The first time you drop below 50% HP in a battle, your next skill costs no HP or MP.

bar.name: Tomb Frost
bar.text: Your first Bone Throw each battle Slows for 1 extra turn.

bar.name: First Thread
bar.text: Your first Dark Bond each battle also heals the ally for 10% of their max HP.

bar.name: Brink Walker
bar.text: Once per battle, when you drop below 25% HP, Wail of the Dead's cooldown resets.

0.f1.name: Thin Blood
0.f1.text: While below 50% HP, Vampiric Bite heals +4% more of the damage you deal per rank.

0.f2.name: Tithe Collector
0.f2.text: After you pay HP for a skill, that skill drains +3% more per rank through Vampiric Bite.

0.f3.name: Open Veins
0.f3.text: Your skills deal +1% damage per rank for every 10% of HP you are missing.

0.n0.name: Sanguine Thirst
0.n0.text: While below 50% HP, the first hit you land each turn drains double through Vampiric Bite.

0.r.name: Last Drop
0.r.text: The first time you fall below 30% HP in a battle, heal 5% of your max HP per rank.

0.ea.name: Dying Light
0.ea.text: While below 50% HP, your skills ignore 20% of the target's magic armor.

0.eb.name: Black Spittle
0.eb.text: Your direct hits Wound the target for 2 turns.

0.ma.name: Undying Thirst
0.ma.text: Once per battle, a fatal hit leaves you at 1 HP instead, and your next hit drains 100% of its damage.

0.fa.name: Gaunt Frame
0.fa.text: Vampiric Bite heals 70% of damage dealt instead of 50%, but your maximum HP is 20% lower.

0.fb.name: Rancid Blood
0.fb.text: Wound you inflict lasts 2 turns longer, but Vampiric Bite heals 20% less.

0.mb.name: Stolen Remedy
0.mb.text: When an enemy you Wounded is healed, you heal for the amount Wound blocked.

0.v.name: Crimson Tide
0.v.text: Vampiric Bite evolves: each time you pay HP for a skill, it heals +5% more of damage dealt for the rest of the battle.

1.f1.name: Knee Breaker
1.f1.text: Bone Throw +4% damage per rank against Slowed targets.

1.f2.name: Marrow Leech
1.f2.text: Vampiric Bite heals +3% more per rank from Bone Throw hits on Slowed targets.

1.f3.name: Skull Rattle
1.f3.text: Bone Throw has a 3% chance per rank to Stagger its target (it loses its next action).

1.n0.name: Crippling Bone
1.n0.text: Bone Throw's Slow lasts 3 turns instead of 2.

1.r.name: Numb Joints
1.r.text: Bone Throw +5% damage per rank against Staggered, Stunned or Silenced targets.

1.ea.name: Shattered Shin
1.ea.text: Bone Throw on an already Slowed target has a 25% chance to Stagger it.

1.eb.name: Skull Cracker
1.eb.text: Bone Throw has a 30% chance to Silence its target for 1 turn.

1.ma.name: Grave Shackle
1.ma.text: Bone Throw Stuns a Slowed target below 50% HP for 1 turn (each enemy once per battle).

1.fa.name: Brutal Hurl
1.fa.text: Shattered Shin's chance 25% → 45%, but Bone Throw deals 20% less damage.

1.fb.name: Mute Marrow
1.fb.text: Skull Cracker always Silences, but Bone Throw no longer Slows.

1.mb.name: Jaw Breaker
1.mb.text: Bone Throw on a Silenced target also Jinxes it (accuracy -20%, no crits on its next attack).

1.v.name: Femur Chain
1.v.text: Bone Throw evolves: it hits its target and the enemy behind it, Slowing both for 3 turns.

2.f1.name: Bloody Breath
2.f1.text: Wail of the Dead +1% damage per rank for every 10 HP it costs.

2.f2.name: Lingering Moan
2.f2.text: Vampiric Bite heals +3% more per rank from Wail of the Dead's hits.

2.f3.name: Fearful Keening
2.f3.text: Wail of the Dead has a 4% chance per rank to Blind each enemy hit for 1 turn.

2.n0.name: Scream of Need
2.n0.text: While you are below 50% HP, Wail of the Dead deals +30% damage.

2.r.name: Tithe Refund
2.r.text: For each enemy Wail of the Dead hits, refund 4% of its HP cost per rank.

2.ea.name: Deeper Cut
2.ea.text: Wail of the Dead costs 30% of your current HP instead of 20% and deals +30% damage.

2.eb.name: Blood Hymn
2.eb.text: Wail of the Dead heals your bonded ally for the HP it cost you.

2.ma.name: Blood Banshee
2.ma.text: Wail of the Dead deals bonus dark damage equal to 50% of the HP it cost to every enemy hit.

2.fa.name: Torn Lungs
2.fa.text: Wail of the Dead's cooldown 3 → 2, but it costs 40% of your current HP.

2.fb.name: Bitter Gift
2.fb.text: Blood Hymn heals double, but Wail of the Dead deals 25% less damage.

2.mb.name: Gorging Howl
2.mb.text: If Wail of the Dead hits 3 or more enemies, it refunds its full HP cost.

2.v.name: Banshee's Toll
2.v.text: Wail of the Dead evolves: it hits every enemy on the field, costs 30% of current HP and drains double.

3.f1.name: Thick Blood
3.f1.text: Dark Bond passes +4% more of your healing per rank.

3.f2.name: Kindred Pulse
3.f2.text: When Dark Bond starts, heal the bonded ally for 2% of your max HP per rank.

3.f3.name: Kindred Guard
3.f3.text: Your bonded ally takes 2% less damage per rank.

3.n0.name: Lifeline
3.n0.text: When the bonded ally drops below 30% HP, your next hit drains double and sends all of it to them.

3.r.name: Blood Kin
3.r.text: While you are below 50% HP, Dark Bond passes +5% more of your healing per rank.

3.ea.name: Transfusion
3.ea.text: Dark Bond also moves 15% of your current HP to the bonded ally as healing.

3.eb.name: Soul Shield
3.eb.text: Dark Bond gives the ally a shield worth 15% of your max HP.

3.ma.name: Life for Life
3.ma.text: Once per battle, a fatal hit on the bonded ally is redirected to you instead.

3.fa.name: Bled Dry
3.fa.text: Transfusion moves 30% of your current HP instead of 15%, but Dark Bond's cooldown 2 → 3.

3.fb.name: Iron Oath
3.fb.text: Blood Oath takes 60% instead of 30%, but Vampiric Bite heals you 20% less.

3.mb.name: Blood Oath
3.mb.text: While bonded, you guard your ally: you take 30% of the damage aimed at them.

3.v.name: Crimson Covenant
3.v.text: Dark Bond evolves: it no longer ends after 3 turns; it holds until one of you falls or you bind another.

4.u1.name: Grasping Hands
4.u1.text: Your Skeleton's hits Slow the target for 1 turn.

4.u2.name: Cold Grip
4.u2.text: Your Skeleton deals +20% damage to Slowed targets.

4.u3.name: Grave Grasp
4.u3.text: Your Skeleton's first attack Stuns its target for 1 turn.

4.r1.name: Pox Bloom
4.r1.text: When your Skeleton dies or expires, poison ground (15% INT, 2 turns) spreads under the enemy it last hit.

4.r2.name: Spore Cloud
4.r2.text: Pox Bloom's ground also covers the cells beside that enemy.

4.r3.name: Rot Bomb
4.r3.text: Pox Bloom also detonates all Withering on enemies inside its ground.

4.d1.name: Fresh Meat
4.d1.text: A fed Skeleton gains +15% damage and +15% max HP.

4.d2.name: Gravedigger
4.d2.text: With no corpse on the field, Raise Dead costs 8 more MP and raises a fed Skeleton anyway.

4.d3.name: Tomb Knight
4.d3.text: A fed Skeleton's Bone Slash has no cooldown.

4.l1.name: Hulking Frame
4.l1.text: Your Skeleton has +20% max HP and lives 1 turn longer.

4.l2.name: Grave Plate
4.l2.text: Your Skeleton gains +10 armor and is Fortified on its first turn.

4.l3.name: Bone Champion
4.l3.text: Your Skeleton lives until slain, but Raise Dead's cooldown 5 → 7.
